article.body:
UK MOD updates toponymic factfiles

The Ministry of Defence updated its Toponymic factfiles guidance on 25 September 2026, revising entries for Egypt, India, Malta, Norway, Portugal and Yemen. The published guidance enables users to apply Permanent Committee on Geographical Names rules for writing geographical names outside the UK, excluding Antarctica. Its objective is consistent use of geographical names in official work. The guidance is published and in effect; no new contract or funding commitment is attached.
